name: 1Win
summary: Crypto casino and sportsbook. Near-black canvas, vivid green action color, dense game-tile rails
description: An analysis of 1win's design language — a near-black crypto casino and sportsbook built on Inter at heavy weights, where a vivid green action color and an electric blue secondary carry every CTA across dense, full-bleed game-tile rails, promo cards, and live betting panels on a flat dark-grey surface ladder.

colors.name: Action Green
colors.role: The primary action color — the "Registration" CTA, primary confirms, betslip place-bet, and section accent icons. The brand's "go / win" signal.

colors.name: Electric Blue
colors.role: The secondary action — "Log In", text links, the "Show more" pill, active tabs, badges, and live/betting highlights.

colors.name: On Primary
colors.role: White text/icons on the green and blue fills.

colors.name: Canvas
colors.role: The page background and the fill of the nav and `sidebar-rail` — a flat near-black.

colors.name: Surface
colors.role: Cards, game tiles, promo cards, betslip panels, utility buttons, and input fields — the single elevated dark step.

colors.name: Hairline
colors.role: The faint 1px divider/card border, a translucent cool-grey edge that reads against both canvas and surface.

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Primary text, the wordmark, and headings — a soft off-white.

colors.name: Muted
colors.role: Secondary labels, inactive nav glyphs, footer text.

colors.name: Black
colors.role: Maximum-contrast text used on the brightest accent fills and light promo surfaces.

substitutesNote: Inter is an open-source Google Font, so no substitution is needed. If a fallback is required, any grotesque with a strong semibold (e.g. Manrope, Geist) preserves the heavy-weight character; keep body at 600+ to retain the app-like density.

ex-pricing-tier.description: Default Pricing tier card. Re-uses feature-card chrome with brand canvas-soft surface.

ex-pricing-tier-featured.description: Featured/highlighted tier — polarity-flipped surface (dark fill + light text in light mode, light fill + dark text in dark mode).

ex-product-selector.description: What's Included summary card — re-purposed for SaaS / B2B verticals (NOT a literal product gallery).

ex-cart-drawer.description: Subscription summary — re-purposed for SaaS / B2B (line items per add-on, not literal cart).

ex-app-shell-row.description: Sidebar nav row inside the App Shell example. Active state uses brand primary as the indicator.

ex-data-table-cell.description: Default data-table th + td chrome. Header uses mono-caps eyebrow typography; body uses body-sm.

ex-auth-form-card.description: Sign-in / sign-up card. Re-uses feature-card chrome with text-input primitives inside.

ex-modal-card.description: Modal dialog surface — same chrome as feature-card with elevated shadow.

ex-toast.description: Toast notification surface — feature-card shape + medium shadow.
